{"reason": "Eight wrong rows are demand-forecast-error mislabeled unknown: three have forecast-bias with small amounts (0.065-0.081, under the 0.1 threshold) and five have market-mismatch=#t with no bias flag. I replaced the forecast branch condition with an OR adding market-signal-mismatch and lowered the bias threshold to 0.05, recovering ~1,226,000 and lifting accuracy/recovery.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05))
         (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
